name: LIN D

children.text: LIN D is a pop trio of siblings Dennis, Emmy and Ella Lindéh from Örebro, Sweden. Their sound blends pop, R&B and gospel with Swedish pop melodies, and all three write the songs while Dennis produces. In 2024 they played 38 US arena shows on the Winter Jam tour, and their 2025 single Move became their breakthrough. Their albums Honest To God (2025) and Honest To God II (2026) are out now.
